_about: Single prompt template for every creature image. Only `subject` and `motion` (taken from creatures.json) vary per creature; everything else is shared verbatim. pipeline/build_prompts.py renders it.

reference.observed: Analog scan look: flash-lit editorial photograph reproduced as a worn paper print, cold desaturated blue-grey cast, heavy film grain and fine halftone, hair-thin handwritten ink script and monospace captions (omitted from the images), dynamic subjects frozen mid-action with directional smear (whipping hair on the cover).

asset_type: isolated cut-out creature portrait for a Pokedex-style index (later reduced to a 1-bit pixel sprite)
style: editorial analog photograph, a flash-lit 35mm frame scanned from a worn, over-inked paper print, in the manner of an experimental fashion-magazine collage cover: cold desaturated blue-grey colour grade with cyan-blue shadows and bleached highlights, deep contrast, crushed blacks, one hard on-camera flash with soft falloff, muted natural colour of the animal only faintly visible under the cold grade
lens_and_film: pushed 35mm film at ISO 3200, 50mm lens, f/2.8, 1/30s drag shutter, slightly overexposed highlights, visible halation and faint chromatic fringing
texture: very visible coarse monochrome film grain across the whole animal, fine halftone dot rosette in the midtones, scanner dust specks, faint paper fibre and ink-bleed on the edges, a worn photocopy feel
palette: near-monochrome: heavily desaturated to about 20 percent saturation, a steel blue-grey cast over the whole animal, no vivid reds, yellows, greens or oranges, tonal range from deep blue-black to bleached white
blur: gradient blur: crisp focus on the head and eyes, blur increasing smoothly and progressively along the body toward the tail, ending in a strong directional motion-blur smear of the tail and trailing fins (follow-through) with a soft ghosted echo of the previous frame
motion_vocabulary: caught mid-motion, ease-out deceleration, follow-through in the trailing fins, squash and stretch in the body curve, a hint of anticipation in the pose
background: pure flat white, exactly #FFFFFF, completely uniform, no gradient, no vignette, no shadow on the ground, no water surface, no props
composition: single creature, fully inside the frame with generous white margin, centered, side-on profile swimming toward the right, long axis horizontal, occupying about 70 percent of the frame width, square 1:1 frame
subject: {subject}
negative: text, letters, captions, watermark, logo, signature, border, frame, collage tiles, human, hand, fishing gear, other animals, scenery, river, waves, colour background, grey background, drop shadow, cartoon, illustration, 3d render, extra fins, extra limbs, deformed anatomy, split image
template: Use case: {use_case}. Asset type: {asset_type}. Style: {style}. Camera and film: {lens_and_film}. Texture: {texture}. Palette: {palette}. Blur: {blur}. Motion language: {motion_vocabulary}. Subject: {subject}. Specific motion: {motion}. Background: {background}. Composition: {composition}. Avoid: {negative}.
